collection.description: A teacher speculates that distant children might learn through toys, pictures, games, and devices unlike anything on Isola.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: A teacher speculates that distant children might learn through toys, pictures, games, and devices unlike anything on Isola.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The children invent a counting game with shells and prove that curiosity needs no machine.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: A teacher wonders whether distant games could teach skills unavailable here.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: An apprentice fears that children might be judged by constant examinations.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: Another villager imagines schools that welcome many ways of learning.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The council asks whether every child could attend, including children who work or need assistance.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: A parent wonders who would care for babies while older children study.
